snippet.title: At Night: Haunted Ride Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Either Eye Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4577180/?utm_source=yt&utm_campaign=hr&utm_medium=sm

The grand opening of the Haunted Mine Ride is tomorrow. Tonight, you run the final test rides. Ride the minecart, Fix props, repeat rides and don’t make "them" notice you.
